material_systems.name: Economy Acrylic-Urethane Trim
material_systems.description: Budget trim paint for rental turnover and economy work.

products.notes: Contractor-grade water-based enamel. Good adhesion to factory primer.

material_systems.name: Standard Modified Urethane Trim
material_systems.description: Standard residential NC trim paint. Modified urethane for durability and flow.

products.notes: Alkyd-like flow and leveling with water cleanup. Reduces brush marks.

material_systems.name: Premium Modified Urethane Trim
material_systems.description: Premium residential NC trim paint. Emerald-tier products.

products.notes: Premium formulation for maximum durability, leveling, and scuff resistance.

coverage_profiles.notes: Based on typical 3-4 inch trim profile. Coverage varies with profile complexity.
Brush application uses slightly more material per LF than spray.

consumables.name: Acrylic Latex Caulk
consumables.notes: NC caulk consumption ~72 LF per tube per Materials doctrine

consumables.name: Lightweight Spackle
consumables.specification: Lightweight paintable spackle for fastener hole filling
consumables.notes: NC fastener fill consumption 3-5x higher than repaint per doctrine. Standard density: 2 stacked holes every 12-16 inches.

consumables.name: Wood Filler/Putty
consumables.specification: Stainable/paintable wood filler for open grain filling
consumables.notes: For filling open grain at casing ends. Quantity based on door/window opening counts.

consumables.name: Sanding Sponge 220 Grit
consumables.specification: Sanding sponge, fine 220 grit for between-coat sanding

consumables.name: 2.5-inch Angled Brush
consumables.notes: Primary brush for trim work per Materials doctrine

consumables.name: 2-inch Touch-Up Brush
consumables.specification: 2-inch angled brush for touch-up and patching
consumables.notes: For spot coating patches and final touch-up

consumables.name: Spray Tip 310
consumables.specification: Airless spray tip 310 for trim enamel
consumables.notes: 310 or 312 tip for trim work - smaller fan, fine atomization

consumables.name: Rosin Paper
consumables.specification: Rosin paper for floor protection, 36-inch roll
consumables.notes: Required for spray application floor protection

consumables.name: Masking Paper 12-inch
consumables.notes: For masking adjacent surfaces during spray

caulk.notes: Per Materials doctrine: NC ~72 LF per tube

spackle.calculation: Based on 2 stacked holes every 12-16 inches = ~1.5-2 hole pairs per LF
spackle.waste_factor: 3-5x higher than repaint due to overfill-and-sand method
spackle.notes: Per Materials doctrine: NC trim fastener fill has high waste factor

wood_filler_open_grain.calculation: (Door openings x 2) + (Window openings x 4) = total ends to fill
wood_filler_open_grain.notes: Minimal material per end - one tube covers many openings

sanding_materials.notes: Consumption increases with quality tier due to more thorough sanding
